title: Section 517.43 – Revise the title and first paragraph of Section 517.43 to read as follows:
officialText:
517.43 Automatic Connection to Life Safety Branch. The life safety branch shall be installed and connected to the
alternate source of power specified in 517.41 so that all functions specified herein for the life safety branch are
automatically restored to operation within 10 seconds after interruption of the normal source.
